name: vaultguard-backend
description: VaultGuard Enterprise Password Manager Backend API

scripts.start: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$port = 5000; $processIds = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($processIds) { foreach ($procId in $processIds) { try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "Stopped process $procId using port $port" } catch { } } }; node server.js"
